title: Pin and review the HackiOS userland repository (oosexgang/hackios-xnu-userland: init, injected libraries, launchd job definitions, APFS image builder, IPSW extractor) as a research source at a full SHA; extract what it does to the iOS 16.5 root and which launchd jobs it keeps. Two donors (y2sios, ios-lemonadep) derive their userland from it, but its content is only known from their notices.
acceptance: research/sources.json gets a hackios-userland entry pinned to a full SHA with its licence notes (clone via tools/sources.py into references/, no script from it executed); sources.py verify is clean.

The note lists, with path @ blob id, the root-preparation steps, the init program, injected libraries and launchd job set, the root builder's inputs and outputs, and for each whether the project already has an equivalent; donor claims stay claims.
It names what a project-owned root composer (IOS-008) must reproduce versus what can be omitted.
steps: Read the builder and job list
